component.name: LivePlayer
component.script:
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("video") m.overlay = m.top.findNode("overlay") m.channelName = m.top.findNode("channelName") m.videoTitle = m.top.findNode("videoTitle") m.errorLabel = m.top.findNode("errorLabel") m.hideTimer = m.top.findNode("hideOverlay")
' Loading UI m.loadingPanel = m.top.findNode("loadingPanel") m.loadingChannel = m.top.findNode("loadingChannel") m.loadingStatus = m.top.findNode("loadingStatus") m.loadingHint = m.top.findNode("loadingHint") m.pulseBars = [ m.top.findNode("pulseBar1"), m.top.findNode("pulseBar2"), m.top.findNode("pulseBar3"), m.top.findNode("pulseBar4") ] m.pulseColors = ["0xE11D48FF", "0xE11D48AA", "0xE11D4866", "0xE11D4833"] m.dotsTimer = m.top.findNode("dotsTimer") m.dotsStep = 0
m.hideTimer.observeField("fire", "onHideOverlay") m.dotsTimer.observeField("fire", "onDotsTick") m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") end sub
sub onChannelSet() ch = m.top.channel m.channelName.text = ch.name showAndScheduleHide() playCurrentSlot() end sub
sub playCurrentSlot() ch = m.top.channel nowUtc = getUtcSeconds() slot = getCurrentVideo(ch, nowUtc) if slot = invalid showLoading(false) m.errorLabel.text = "No video scheduled right now." return end if
m.currentSlot = slot m.videoTitle.text = slot.video.title
' Uploaded R2 video — direct play if slot.video.video_url <> invalid and Len(slot.video.video_url) > 0 showLoading(true, "Loading video") startPlayback(slot.video.video_url, slot.seek) return end if
' YouTube-sourced — resolve URL async via Task (7-8s wait) if slot.video.youtube_id <> invalid and Len(slot.video.youtube_id) > 0 showLoading(true, "Tuning in") m.streamFetcher = CreateObject("roSGNode", "DataFetcher") m.streamFetcher.url = m.top.backendBase + "/api/youtube/stream-info/" + slot.video.youtube_id m.streamFetcher.observeField("response", "onStreamResolved") m.streamFetcher.control = "RUN" return end if
m.errorLabel.text = "No playable source. Skipping..." skipToNext() end sub
sub onStreamResolved() body = m.streamFetcher.response if Len(body) = 0 showLoading(false) m.errorLabel.text = "Stream unavailable. Skipping..." skipToNext() return end if info = ParseJson(body) if info = invalid or info.success <> true or info.url = invalid showLoading(false) m.errorLabel.text = "Stream unavailable. Skipping..." skipToNext() return end if startPlayback(info.url, m.currentSlot.seek) end sub
sub startPlayback(url as String, seek as Integer) m.errorLabel.text = "" content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.title = m.currentSlot.video.title content.url = url content.streamFormat = detectFormat(url) m.video.content = content m.video.seekMode = "accurate" m.video.seek = seek m.video.control = "play" end sub
function detectFormat(url as String) as String u = LCase(url) if Instr(1, u, ".m3u8") > 0 then return "hls" if Instr(1, u, ".mpd") > 0 then return "dash" return "mp4" end function
sub onVideoState() s = m.video.state if s = "playing" ' Real frames rendering — hide loading panel showLoading(false) else if s = "finished" playCurrentSlot() ' next slot else if s = "error" showLoading(false) m.errorLabel.text = "Playback error. Skipping..." skipToNext() end if end sub
sub skipToNext() ' Simple skip: recompute slot after a short delay timer = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") timer.duration = 2 timer.observeField("fire", "playCurrentSlot") m.top.appendChild(timer) timer.control = "start" end sub
sub showAndScheduleHide() m.overlay.visible = true m.hideTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onHideOverlay() m.overlay.visible = false end sub
' ---------- Loading Overlay ---------- sub showLoading(visible as Boolean, statusText = "Tuning in" as String) m.loadingPanel.visible = visible if visible m.loadingChannel.text = m.top.channel.name m.loadingStatus.text = statusText m.loadingHint.text = "Press BACK to return to the guide" m.dotsStep = 0 m.dotsTimer.control = "start" else m.dotsTimer.control = "stop" end if end sub
sub onDotsTick() m.dotsStep = (m.dotsStep + 1) mod 4 dots = "" for i = 1 to m.dotsStep dots = dots + "." end for base = m.loadingStatus.text ' Strip trailing dots to get the base label while Len(base) > 0 and Right(base, 1) = "." base = Left(base, Len(base) - 1) end while m.loadingStatus.text = base + dots
' Rotate the pulse bar colors for a marquee-style animation n = m.pulseBars.Count() if n > 0 offset = m.dotsStep mod n for i = 0 to n - 1 idx = (i + offset) mod n m.pulseBars[i].color = m.pulseColors[idx] end for end if end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" or key = "options" showLoading(false) m.video.control = "stop" m.top.closed = true return true end if if key = "up" or key = "down" showAndScheduleHide() return true end if if key = "OK" or key = "play" showAndScheduleHide() return true end if return false end function
